name: albino-demon-E-run6-side-v01

request.prompt: STRICT RIGHT-FLANK SIDE CAMERA AND ALTERNATING LEGS are the purpose of this dedicated ALBINO DEMON boss RUN repair. Make NEW original painted dark fantasy RPG keyframes. All SIX figures face exactly EAST toward SCREEN RIGHT in the SAME PURE RIGHT-SIDE PROFILE camera with only slight elevation15degrees: nose/snout/toes and axe point RIGHT, only ONE near eye visible. See the character's anatomical RIGHT FLANK, NOT the FRONT of chest. Front pectoral surface and frontal skull-belt face point off-screen RIGHT and must be HIDDEN/EDGE-ON. Shoulder plates overlap in profile. The far horn is partly occluded by near horn, not spread symmetrically to camera. Never reproduce the reference's SE three-quarter front camera. Reference supplies equipment/anatomy only, redraw viewpoint. Preserve muscular deep RED demon with TWO black swept ridged horns, one head, TWO arms, TWO clawed legs, heavy SPIKED dark gunmetal shoulder/forearm/shin armor, skull belt seen EDGE-ON, iron chains, loincloth, thick tail curled near rear hip. No wings, white recolor, shield, sword or lava/fist-golem. Anatomical RIGHT arm is NEAR camera and holds ONE huge crescent iron AXE with wood shaft low-forward RIGHT throughout; anatomical LEFT arm is FAR and its claw stays EMPTY. Do not flip full body or switch axe hands to show opposite support. RUN six real articulated heavy-body phases, changing hip/knee/ankle anatomy, not6stilltranslations. EXACTLY SIX complete connected figures in TWO COLUMNS by THREE ROWS. LEFT COLUMN top-to-bottom is phases0,1,2 = NEAR anatomical RIGHT leg support halfcycle. RIGHT COLUMN top-to-bottom is phases3,4,5 = FAR anatomical LEFT leg support halfcycle. Thus TOP LEFT phase0 versus TOP RIGHT phase3 visibly show OPPOSITE support legs. In every figure the near RIGHT leg has closer plate overlaps/brighter side light; FAR LEFT leg is behind and slightly darker, so anatomical ownership is traceable without colors/labels. Phase0 TOP LEFT: NEAR RIGHT leg extends FORWARD to SCREEN RIGHT and its broad claw/toes are FLAT at lowest ground line bearing weight; FAR LEFT knee is HIGH with curled toes lifted above ground. Phase1 MIDDLE LEFT: NEAR RIGHT sole remains planted under hip, FAR LEFT leg swings forward bent with toe tips clearly raised, torso compresses under axe weight. Phase2 BOTTOM LEFT: NEAR RIGHT leg pushes BACK with heel raised/toes pushing, FAR LEFT knee advances high to prepare next landing. Phase3 TOP RIGHT: FAR LEFT leg extends FORWARD toward RIGHT and its claw/toes are FLAT at lowest ground line bearing weight; NEAR RIGHT knee is HIGH, its clearly foreground foot curled and LIFTED above ground. This must NOT be phase0 repeated with a different torso. Phase4 MIDDLE RIGHT: FAR LEFT sole planted under hip, NEAR RIGHT leg swings forward flexed and its toes lifted, body compression counterpart. Phase5 BOTTOM RIGHT: FAR LEFT leg pushes BACK on toe-off and NEAR RIGHT knee advances high. Both anatomical legs always present, no extra legs, no same support leg in both top figures. Tail, horned head and heavy RIGHT-hand axe counterbalance subtly, axe stays in near RIGHT gripping hand in every phase. Entire full figure including axe/horns/tail/toes SMALL within middle HALF of each cell with broad transparent gutters and outer border, no overlapping rectangles or clipped edges. ONE connected solid character silhouette percell; no detached ornaments, ground, castshadow, glow, particles, dust, text, grids or labels. TRUE alpha0 transparentbackground. Do not put any brown/black background paint or halo into alpha.
